principle: AOT for execution; a governed runtime JIT for selective specialization and deep tracing; one telemetry runtime for context propagation and export

modes.off: pure AOT fast path; no span recording or export work
modes.probes: precompiled probe sites activated at runtime, no code generation
modes.deep: selected functions recompiled with detailed probes and switched in through versioned dispatch

authority.requester: authorized operators only; guest code can never request instrumentation, executable memory or compilation
authority.scope: one request names one tenant; an operator must hold that tenant; functions of another tenant are refused
authority.untrustedTenants: the instrumented variant is produced by the trusted code producer from the tenant's validated artifact and re-validated (instrumented Wasm validated before lowering, or Truffle instrumentation inside the tenant's Graal isolate); native code is never patched in place

execution.aotAuthoritative: a failed, mismatched or unvalidated compile leaves the running version untouched
execution.dispatch: new calls switch to the new version at a safe point; the previous version stays live until its in-flight calls end; the AOT version is never discarded
execution.compileService: compilation runs on a separate, per-tenant quota-controlled service and never on an actor turn
execution.realtime: no deep recompilation or code switch inside real-time sections; prepare variants outside them
execution.off: turning instrumentation off returns dispatch to the AOT version; JIT versions are reclaimed once drained

telemetry.buffers: bounded per tenant, preallocated where possible; full buffers drop and count, never block or grow
telemetry.export: OTLP (HTTP/protobuf or gRPC) export is asynchronous and off the execution path
telemetry.attributes: allowlisted keys only; payloads, bodies, secrets, credentials and arbitrary actor state are never captured; per-key cardinality is capped
telemetry.context: trace context rides immutably in the actor message envelope and in suspended continuations, never in OS thread-locals; it survives suspension, migration and carrier changes
telemetry.propagation: W3C traceparent/tracestate at external boundaries; incoming context is correlation only, validated, and never grants tenant identity or authority
telemetry.links: fan-out and batch consumption use span links rather than invented parent-child edges

java.deep: Truffle instrumentation inside the tenant's Graal isolate

llvm.deep: trusted: LLVM ORC on retained instrumentation IR; untrusted: instrumented Wasm re-validated and re-lowered into the tenant cage

net.probes: precompiled probe variants in the NativeAOT image (no CIL JIT in NativeAOT)
net.deep: untrusted tenants are Wasm on the native core, so the LLVM re-lowering path covers them

wasm.deep: instrumented module variant, re-validated, swapped through the actor version protocol

forge.deep: none until validated code generation exists

js.deep: instrumented Wasm or JS variant instantiated by the host; V8 internals are not controlled

artifacts: a compact, signed, validated instrumentation IR is an optional build artifact, separate from minimal production AOT builds
